author: (d'Orbigny, 1847)

note.en: A frog shell listed for the Costa Rican Caribbean as Bursa thomae by Espinosa and Ortea (2001), a new record for the country. Few details are available locally. Size is a rough estimate, to be checked.
note.es: Un caracol rana citado para el Caribe de Costa Rica como Bursa thomae por Espinosa y Ortea (2001), un registro nuevo para el país. Hay pocos detalles locales. El tamaño es una estimación aproximada, por verificar.

evidence: Listed in Espinosa & Ortea 2001 as Bursa thomae (new record for Costa Rica)

sources.t: Espinosa & Ortea 2001, Moluscos del mar Caribe de Costa Rica, Avicennia suppl. 4

recWhy: New record listed in the Cahuita to Gandoca catalogue (Espinosa & Ortea 2001).
